style: [STYLE] 3D animation movie still, rendered in authentic Disney Pixar style using Unreal Engine 5 / Octane Render with full ray tracing. Smooth stylized characters, soft clay materials, subsurface scattering (SSS) on skin, volumetric lighting, ray-traced soft shadows, rich cinematic color grade. Setting: a timeless fairy-tale kingdom where nature itself makes music: ringing springs, trees with strings of light, crystal wind chimes, tiny glowing musical notes drifting like fireflies. Backgrounds feel like a lush painterly matte painting with soft atmospheric perspective, while characters stay crisp clean Pixar 3D. Subtle turquoise and gold LED-neon glow inside water, crystals and light-strings only, never on the characters. 16:9.
rules: [RULES] Inside the kingdom all characters are men and boys in modest long clothing. In the modern-day finale each woman or man appears alone in the shot, women in modest dress with a headscarf or a wig, never touching anyone. The king's crown always matches the approved crown sheet: a tall gold crown of cresting water-wave arches cradling one huge diamond at the top; never a cross, orb, fleur-de-lis or any heraldic shape. No crosses, churches, stained-glass windows, steeples, onion domes, minarets, icons, idols, flags, coats of arms or heraldic symbols, not even tiny or blurred in the background. No halos or glowing rings around heads. No text, letters or labels anywhere. Mouths of speaking characters stay clearly visible; listeners keep their mouths closed. One consistent 3D Pixar render style.
